description: as cfd_2d_dambreak with the free surface from the PIC particles (F 81 1, phase 1): the level set is not transported, phi comes from the water fraction of the particles (kernel 2 cells, mirror images at the walls), reinitialised; the particles move with the water velocity extended into the air; particles kept in the water (F 86 1)
covers: pic_f_phi: water fraction, table of the flat surface, band and old values, solid extension, reinitialisation, density update
pic_f_extend: the water velocity extended into the air
